about: Made-up layout rules. main_compiled.json is what origin/main's shared/layout_rules.compile_adjustments made of these at 5b033c35a, unchanged since #3796 (generated once from that file, never by this branch's code); with the switch off this branch must make the same bytes, reach fields or not.

adjustments.text: In every mediation brief, two blank lines before the court name.
Memos and depo outlines: single spaced signature block.
Never use the word plainly; three blank lines before the caption.
Leave extra space between the court name and the caption.
Charts in 12 point in our briefs.
Put the date beside the by line.
Discovery responses: 6 pt before each heading.
Two blank lines before the court name.
If it is a long brief, double spaced throughout.
